items.source:
If the property was the same as the current, the sort is reversed if
"toggleAscendingOnProperty" is activated, else simply ignored.
items.translation: 如果属性与当前属性相同，则当激活“toggleAscendingOnProperty”时反转排序顺序，否则直接忽略。

items.source:
This is particularly useful for parameter binding through a web request,
where clicking on the field header again might be supposed to trigger a
resort for the same field but opposite order.
items.translation: 这对于通过 Web 请求进行参数绑定特别有用，其中再次点击字段标题可能旨在触发同一字段的重新排序，但顺序相反。

items.source: Mutable implementation of the SortDefinition interface. Supports toggling the ascending value on setting the same property again.
items.translation: `SortDefinition` 接口的可变实现。支持在再次设置相同属性时切换升序值。

items.source: Set whether to toggle the ascending flag if the same property gets set again (that is, setProperty(String) gets called with already set property name again).
items.translation: 设置是否在再次设置相同属性时切换升序标志（即，当已设置的属性名再次被调用setProperty(String)时）。

items.source: Return whether to toggle the ascending flag if the same property gets set again (that is, setProperty gets called with already set property name again).
items.translation: 返回是否切换升序标志，如果再次设置相同的属性（即再次调用 `setProperty` 且属性名已设置）。
